bullets.text: Sole product designer delivering end-to-end design across 5+ digital platforms in government, cultural, and immersive-tech contexts, taking products from research and concept through to shipped, developer-handed-off builds. Worked within agile sprint cycles, setting design milestones, and collaborating directly with engineering and product stakeholders.
peopleSignals: collaborating directly with engineering and product stakeholders

bullets.text: Increased walkthrough completion from under 5% to ~31% by replacing linear navigation with hotspot-based exploration across 3 user segments; on a separate platform, increased content discovery from under 1% to ~13%.
Shipped live products across government, institutional, and exhibition contexts; on a live AR exhibition product, measured 6.1/7 satisfaction across 22 on-site users through structured testing.
Conducted ethnographic fieldwork visiting artisans on-site to translate lived craft practice into navigable digital experiences.

Integrated engineering earlier in the design cycle, sat with developers during implementation including Unity UI work, and structured developer handoff, cutting revision cycles by ~40% and late-stage rework by ~12%.
Contributed UX strategy and design assets to a government portal concept delivered in 7 days, supporting a $4M public-sector partnership opportunity.

Independent product design for early-stage startups: built complete product foundations from partial briefs (user flows, design systems, edge cases, error and empty states, monetisation), and advised pre-seed founders on UX and AI interaction standards including source transparency and recommendation framing. Work incorporated into client builds and investor materials.
scopeSignals: complete product foundations from partial briefs

bullets.text: Led mixed-methods research to address gender bias and build trust in AI-driven financial products during high-stakes financial moments.
Designed a predictive AI financial companion for women that detects high-risk financial moments and intervenes in real time, using behavioural and physiological signals without removing user agency.
Grounded in 130+ surveys and 15+ interviews; identified trust breakdown points across onboarding friction, unfamiliar-market anxiety, and gender-skewed assumptions.

Developed a Trust Pyramid framework governing how AI earns credibility progressively; tested across three intervention models, achieving a 60% increase in positive user feedback. Presented findings and product direction to EY's design team.
peopleSignals: Presented findings and product direction to EY's design team

bullets.text: Led a team of 12 designers to redesign the Monzo savings flow.
Led MVP scoping and patient-side product design for a dual-sided healthcare marketplace responding to NHS access delays, connecting patients with verified GPs for same-day home visits in London.
Solved the supply-side chicken-and-egg problem: GPs browse patient demand and build profiles before completing verification, with bookings locked until medical credentials are manually approved.
Designed two distinct patient onboarding entry modes within a single interface: emergency users browse and book first with account creation deferred to payment; routine users onboard fully upfront.
Owned GP compliance onboarding across three progressive stages, mapping documentation and regulatory requirements sequentially to reduce abandonment without compromising compliance.

Scoped the product from 30+ features to 12 across two structured prioritisation workshops, aligning founders, clinical advisors, and engineering on MVP scope. Delivered build-ready MVP and developer-handoff specification, validated through stakeholder review.
peopleSignals: aligning founders, clinical advisors, and engineering

bullets.text: Led systems mapping and business design methods to support the Royal Air Force's goal of reducing carbon emissions and embedding Social Value provisions into procurement and delivery.
Diagnosed the core failure as structural rather than financial: sustainability accountability sat between functions with no clear ownership across the procurement chain.
Designed a Social Value Activation Plan embedding sustainability outcomes into procurement decision-making at the point of design, co-developed with policy, procurement, and delivery stakeholders.
peopleSignals: co-developed with policy, procurement, and delivery stakeholders

bullets.text: Co-Led 60-day women's health sprint (VOXAGO INDIA): 190 surveys, 50 interviews, ecosystem and journey mapping across access barriers to women's health services in India.
Coordinated enterprise Agile and Design Thinking programmes across Southeast Asia.
